cap_text: Formula: 3,600 s ÷ {cycle} s × {bpp} boards = {boards_h} boards/h; × {eff_pct} % line efficiency (planning assumption) = {boards_h_eff}. Month = {days} working days.

roi_lead: Same output ({boards_h_eff} boards/h × {ppb} {process_word} parts = {parts_h} parts/h) by hand vs on the {machine}.
roi_note: Assumptions: {manual_rate} hand-inserted parts per operator-hour; wage {cur} {wage} × {factor} employer factor; machine running cost {cur} {run_cost} / month. Higher real wages shorten payback.
